verdict.rationale: Execution-time limits are a fair question for any compute platform, including a VM-based one like Fly.io, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents CPU-time or wall-clock limits for Machines or Sprites. The claims that Machines are persistent VMs and that agents get their own Linux box suggest long-running work is possible, but they never state the limits a devops lead would need to confirm fit.
